purpose: Define how QArchGauge should extend beyond exact state-vector-executable cases without claiming that every deployment-scale case was fully simulated.

rows.current_exact_anchor: 512-sample 12-feature depth-3 stress case plus PyTorch/XGBoost native gate
rows.proxy_scale_axis: larger samples/features, richer kernels, deeper trainable circuits
rows.architecture_signal: hybrid evaluation count, feature loading, batch/feedback latency, native deadline shift
rows.boundary: proxy record, not deployment-scale state-vector claim

rows.current_exact_anchor: H2O 8-qubit layer-3 VQE stress case plus 104 OpenFermion/PySCF cases
rows.proxy_scale_axis: larger active spaces, Pauli-term grouping, richer ansatz families
rows.architecture_signal: energy quality gap, Pauli-evaluation count, decoder/control and observable batching pressure
rows.boundary: proxy record, not deployment-scale state-vector claim

rows.current_exact_anchor: 20-node MaxCut QAOA stress case plus small-graph practical suite
rows.proxy_scale_axis: 50-100 node graph families with tuned native heuristics/MILP and QAOA metadata
rows.architecture_signal: search budget, circuit evaluations, objective gap, annealing or gate-model suitability
rows.boundary: proxy record, not deployment-scale state-vector claim

rows.current_exact_anchor: 12-qubit 16-step Heisenberg stress case plus Trotter practical suite
rows.proxy_scale_axis: 16-20 qubit sparse/tensor native checks and higher Trotter/observable ladders
rows.architecture_signal: two-qubit depth, observable quality, Krylov/tensor native deadline, analog/digital simulation fit
rows.boundary: proxy record, not deployment-scale state-vector claim
